items.title: Rectangular Components of a Vector (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Rectangular Components of a Vector: a main subheading of 2.2 Vectors, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 23-23.

blocks.text: Kisi vector ka component (hissa) us ki effective value (asal asar) hai kisi di gayi direction mein. Ek vector ko kuch specified (tay shuda) directions mein apne component vectors ka resultant (sab mil kar banne wala vector) samjha ja sakta hai. Aam taur par vector ko aisi do directions mein resolve karte (torte) hain jo ek doosre par perpendicular (90° par) hon. Aise components rectangular components kehlate hain.

Farz karein vector A⃗ ko line OP se dikhaya gaya hai jo x-axis ke saath angle θ banati hai. A⃗ ka x-axis par projection (saya) OM aur y-axis par projection ON banayein (Fig. 2.1). x-direction wala projection OM, A⃗x kehlata hai aur y-direction wala projection ON, A⃗y. Head to tail rule (ek vector ka head doosre ki tail se jorna) lagane se:

blocks.alt: X aur Y axes O par milte hain. Vector A, O se P tak x-axis se angle theta par hai. Us ka component Ax x-axis par O se M tak aur component Ay y-axis par O se N tak hai; dashed (toti hui) lines N ko P se aur P ko M se jorti hain.
